examples.text: Население этой страны меньше, чем население США.
examples.en: The population of this country is smaller than that of the United States.
This town is increasing in population.

examples.text: К 2020 году населения нашего города удвоится.
examples.en: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
There has been a rapid increase in the population here.
There was a steady increase in population.
